Tokyo Night Pedal Cruising (NPC)

Tokyo, Japan · Jingumae, Shibuya · Social

Tokyo Night Pedal Cruising (NPC) is a social group ride in Tokyo, Japan. It rolls third Saturday of the month at 5:30 pm local time from United Nations University. Pace: relatively low speed.

For visitors

RSVP on Meetup. Any kind of bike is fine. Most members are Japanese; the group says foreigners are welcome and it is always happy to meet new people.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: relatively low speed.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Tokyo Night Pedal Cruising (NPC) group ride

A monthly evening ride through Tokyo at an easy pace, on any kind of bike. Each ride has a theme: a six-park loop, a fireworks ride, an all-night lap of the Yamanote line in August. A good first social ride for a visitor who wants the city at night.
